  ⑦《智慧城市建设及产业振兴等相关法律》部分修改如下。

  ⑧省略。

adjudications.reason: The Korean process box '신청서 작성' is split across cells 44/52; avoid duplicating 작성 from adjacent translated cell.

The combination with cell 49 now yields 国家智慧城市委员会审议; Korean is 국가스마트도시위원회 심의, not municipal council.

Finish split checkbox instruction at cell 6; existing cell 7 carries '(앞쪽)'.
Korean annex requires separate owned/rented office with '바닥 면적 45제곱미터 이상'; this is floor area, not an unspecified 45 unit.

Connects row 46 law title with Article 52 and entity name split into cell 48.
